Legacy Level 3 branding persists on some facilities and aggregator listings and is preserved in this registry per its no delete policy rather than overwritten. This specific row, generically named Lumen Cleveland, in Cuyahoga County, Ohio, could not be confidently matched to a specific address this session. A datacentermap area listing for Cleveland, fetched fresh this session, shows three separate numbered Lumen facilities in this city: Lumen Cleveland 1 at 4000 Chester Avenue, Lumen Cleveland 2 at 1228 Euclid Avenue, and Lumen Cleveland 3 at 1621 Euclid Avenue, none individually distinguishable as this specific rows building without a way to match this rows own coordinates to a specific one of the three. Given three genuine candidates and no reliable way to choose among them, this session declined to assign an address rather than guess.
